name: single-fixed-complementarity-control-v1
combination: Arithmetic mean of aligned out-of-fold probabilities, independently for each row. No fitted combiner, rank normalization, rule-specific weights, threshold tuning or new encoder call.
rationale: All seven latest candidates fall below the original centroid in transfer AUC. Semantic-plus-intent has small legal/medical/illegal-promotion gains and an advertising decline. One fixed average tests whether this complementarity is useful without selecting mixture weights.
acceptance: Apply the unchanged practical AUC, per-policy, log-loss and Brier tolerances from feature_decision.json; require a positive paired lower bound. Report rejection. The earlier seven comparisons retain their own simultaneous correction.
timing: Preregistered after inspecting the formatting study and before computing any blend score. This is explicitly adaptive development work, not confirmation.
